_meta.methodology: Independent CP fit assessment by query_text + expected_tags + gate_name, without anchoring on the agent-time original CP. Picks 1-3 best-fit CPs from the existing 49-CP KB; flags 'no_good_fit' with a reason, AND tags would_fit_proposed_cp (CP-050/051/052) when an OOD query would map to a v1.1-proposed but not-yet-minted CP.

proposed_cps_not_in_kb.CP-050: meta_checklist_underreporting (TRIPOD+AI / PROBAST+AI explicit checklist non-compliance / standards-anchored reporting gap)
proposed_cps_not_in_kb.CP-052: shortcut_learning_audit_missing (model relies on non-anatomical / dataset-source / artefact shortcuts; explicit shortcut-audit absent)

_meta.data_caveat_for_v1.1: Many OOD queries describe imaging / shortcut-learning / standards-anchored failures that the 49-CP KB (mostly tabular EHR Nature Comms / Comms Medicine cases) does not cover natively. 'replaced' counts here are higher than v3 indist; 'no_good_fit' counts identify CP-mint candidates.
